Based on the provided documents, the 1804 expedition to explore the Pacific Northwest is known as the Lewis and Clark Expedition (or the Corps of Discovery). While President Thomas Jefferson chose Meriwether Lewis to lead the mission, Lewis selected his army comrade, **William Clark**, to serve as his co-commander and co-leader.
